events.text: Mina: Hi Nell — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and do you need any tools or volunteers?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I’m not totally sure, but that’s what I heard. I could definitely use a volunteer or two, and maybe a basic tool kit if anyone has one.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what’s the latest on it?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Noah: The repair drive is still happening, right? I just want to make sure before I tell anyone else.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Nell: Yeah, that’s what I heard too — it’s still on, but I’m only going by second-hand updates. If you hear anything official, let me know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Eli: I’ll stick to the schedule and bring my part on repair drive day. Just let me know if anything changes.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’ll keep you posted if I hear any changes. We could still use a volunteer or two, and a basic tool kit would be great if you have one.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I’m still going off what I heard, but I think it’s on for Saturday. If anyone can spare a volunteer or a basic tool kit, that would really help.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Tess. That sounds good — keep it easy-going, and I’ll do what I can.
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Kira: Right — just confirming, it’s still looking like a decent turnout already, yes?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Nell: Oh good, that’s reassuring — do we know if there’s anything else people should bring?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Kira: Yes — if they can, extra tools, paint, or a few snacks would still help. I’ll keep the list updated if anyone else chimes in.
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times if that makes the repair drive easier. What do you need from me?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Faye: I can work around pickup times and help where it’s most useful—just tell me what you need.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Nell: Hi Mina — I’m still hearing that it’s on for Saturday, and a volunteer or two plus a basic tool kit would really help.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mina: Thanks, Nell — I can bring a basic tool kit and help out on Saturday. What time and where should I show up?
events.speaker: Mina

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Mina — that’s a huge help. I’m still checking the exact time and spot, but I’ll send you the details as soon as I have them.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: Hey Cleo, I’m still trying to catch up—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Cleo: Thanks for checking in, Nell — we’re still getting our list together, and I’m asking around about what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Nell: Got it — I can help spread the word if you want. Just let me know what supplies or volunteers you still need.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Nell: Hi Mara — I’ve just heard the repair drive is coming up soon. What’s the latest on it?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Mara: Hi Nell — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. If you want to help, I can use a hand with bringing supplies or coordinating setup.
events.speaker: Mara

prov.value: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — Sunday at the community center works for me. I can help with setup or bringing supplies; just let me know what’s most needed.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ve only heard bits and pieces too. If I catch anything official about the repair drive, I’ll let you know.
events.speaker: Noah

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I’m just going off second-hand updates too, so I’d appreciate it. If you hear anything official about the repair drive, please let me know.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Noah: Will do — I’ll pass along anything official if I hear it. Hopefully we get a clear update soon.
events.speaker: Noah
